answer: A bond is meaningless while it is only a number in a database. Key it to a hardware root and require a signature on every claim, then void the bond outright when the audit panel lacks diversity. Trust belongs to one finished job checked by strangers, not to a wallet address. Cloning a certificate is cheap. A farm must forge one hardware root per identity and keep each attesting, which cloned boards cannot do, so it stalls at that line and spreads thin across a karst of mismatched boards. The glacier pace is fine.
